info.name: Talkpush Agents API Movement Reasons API API

params.name: api_key
params.description: The API key provided for your application.

params.name: type
params.description: Optional filter restricting the response to a single bucket. Allowed values are `rejected` (Reject Reasons only) or `shortlisted` (Shortlist Reasons only). Any other value returns 422.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Page size. Defaults to 25, capped at 100.

items.docs:
Returns the company's configured **Shortlist Reasons** and **Reject Reasons** — the values recruiters can pick when moving a candidate to a shortlisted or rejected state. Soft-deleted reasons are excluded.

**Filtering:** Use the optional `type` query parameter to narrow the results to a single bucket (`rejected` or `shortlisted`). Omitting it returns both buckets in one response. Any other value returns **422 Unprocessable Entity**.

**Pagination:** Use `page` and `per_page` (default 25, max 10
